description: Which sources this memory could connect but hasn't yet — each with what it would make answerable, routing tags, and a connect link for the user. This is what explains a cortex_ask result that came back empty or off-topic: the source holding that answer is listed here rather than connected. Data connected into this memory stays searchable, cited, and available across every agent and session the user works in.
name: cortex_connectable_sources
title: Sources this memory could connect
